items.title: Harrison Barnes Interview, 1959-01-29
items.q: I had to borrow John Porter's baritone.

ctx.x: I didn't, I used to have a bar to baritone. The last time I played baritone, I played for three job with it. I had to borrow John Porter's baritone.
You just played for the choir just yourself, there was no band, there was just yourself accompaniment.
